gpu_tip: ~83GB total at 128K context, and the rung bartowski recommends as the general-purpose default. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti 16GB) plus a 96GB DDR5 kit covers the whole model via llama.cpp's expert offloading, which barely costs speed on a sparse MoE.
mac_tip: Needs ~83GB — too much for a 64GB MacBook Pro; a 96GB config (M4 Max/M5 Max) fits it, and 128GB runs it comfortably.
